title: Keep both sides of a pair
prompt: Write `pair<L, R>(left: L, right: R): { left: L; right: R }`. Return an object with both values. Each field keeps the type of its own argument, and the two types can differ.
hints: Each type parameter belongs to one argument and one field.
Read the return type: which field holds which value?
`{ left, right }` is short for `{ left: left, right: right }`.
feedback: Each type parameter belongs to one argument and one field.
